text:
[RDSC.4a.5] **Load ordering.** The loader processes atoms in a
single forward pass. `AlphaNode` atoms must precede any `BetaNode` that
references them via `right_alpha_id` — the compiler guarantees
this by emitting all `AlphaNode` atoms before any `BetaNode`. `BetaNode`-to-`BetaNode`
parent references and `BetaNode`-to-`TerminalNode` leaf wiring are accumulated
as pending references and resolved in one sweep after the
stream ends. After the sweep the loader seeds root betas
(`left_parent_id == 0`) with nil tokens (IRET.19). No second
pass through the stream is required.

**Every `left_parent_id` chain ends at a root beta.** The compiler must not emit
an artefact whose `left_parent_id` references form a cycle, and a loader must
refuse one with `DS_ERR_RETP_INVALID` ([RDSC.11.1]). The check belongs to the
sweep: it is a cheap structural need of the loader ([RDSC.9.9]), since a walk up
the chain has no end on such an artefact.

---

idris.name: rdsc_4a_5__load
idris.note: The loader's single pass, as its result: alphas, chains, then the seeding sweep.

idris.name: rdsc_4a_5__seed
idris.note: Seed a root with the nil token: the wave it starts over the empty memories runs to the terminal, so a rule of only NOT patterns is active from the start. [IRET.7.4]'s 'working memory the left source' is read as this.

idris.name: rdsc_4a_5__load_unique
idris.note: The loaded network's empty working memory is unique.

idris.name: rdsc_4a_5__load_view
idris.note: The loaded, seeded network has the view.

idris.name: rdsc_4a_5__seed_view
idris.note: SEEDING keeps the view: the nil token's wave over the loaded chain.

idris.name: rdsc_4a_5__load_ordered
idris.note: The loaded, seeded network is ordered.

idris.name: rdsc_4a_5__seed_ordered
idris.note: SEEDING keeps the order: the nil token's wave over the loaded chain, from an empty terminal.

idris.name: rdsc_4a_5__load_g
idris.note: The loaded network with the empty set.

idris.name: rdsc_4a_5__load_sound
idris.note: The loaded, seeded network with the empty set is sound.

idris.name: rdsc_4a_5__seed_unfired
idris.note: A SEEDED TERMINAL holds unfired activations only: the seeding wave creates, and what it creates is unfired.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__init_agree
idris.note: THE LOADED NETWORK AND THE EMPTY FIRELOOP STATE AGREE under the program the loaded network lowers to: the rules reflexively, the tables by the seeding, order and well-formedness from nothing.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__init_tables_agree
idris.note: AT THE START the tables agree: FireLoop's first propagation from nothing over empty working memory and the network's seeding hold the same unblocked matches, all unfired.
